faq.q: What statistics does it show as I type?
faq.a: Live counts for words, characters, characters without spaces, sentences, paragraphs, lines, unique words, average word length, average sentence length, longest word, plus a reading time (200 wpm) and speaking time (130 wpm). It also highlights your single longest sentence with its word count. Everything updates on every keystroke and your text auto-saves locally under wordCounterText.

faq.q: Which platform character limits are tracked?
faq.a: A Character Limits panel shows a progress bar and remaining/over count against eight presets: Twitter/X (280), Instagram Caption (2200), Instagram Bio (150), Meta Description (160), Title Tag (60), SMS (160), LinkedIn Post (3000), and YouTube Description (5000). The bar turns red when you exceed a limit and tells you by how many characters.

faq.q: What readability scores does it calculate?
faq.a: Three: Flesch Reading Ease (with a plain-language interpretation of the score band), Flesch-Kincaid Grade Level, and the Gunning Fog Index, each with a grade-level explanation. They're derived from words-per-sentence and syllable counts. The page notes these formulas are a rough signal — they catch over-long sentences and dense vocabulary but can't judge whether the writing is actually clear.

faq.q: Can it analyse keywords and phrases, and export?
faq.a: Yes. It lists the top 15 keywords with count and density (with a toggle to filter common stop words) and finds repeated 2-word and 3-word phrases. You can Export Report as a .txt summary (stats, readability, keywords, longest sentence) and download a word-frequency CSV. Quick case-conversion and remove-extra-spaces buttons are built in too.
